summaries.1: Public scope: PIMS requirements and guidance for PII controllers and processors; all organization types and sizes (ISO.org catalogue).
summaries.2: Harmonized Structure clauses 4–10 (context, leadership, planning, support, operation, performance evaluation, improvement) applied to a PIMS.
summaries.3: Educational split of PII controller vs PII processor responsibilities as described on ISO.org.
summaries.4: Standalone MSS compatible with ISO/IEC 27001; helps demonstrate — not replace — GDPR and other privacy law.
